ValueSet: MII VS Patho Problem List [SNOMED CT]

Official URL: https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/ext/modul-patho/ValueSet/mii-vs-patho-problem-list-snomed-ct Version: 2027.0.0-ballot.rc2
Active as of 2026-09-08 Computable Name: MII_VS_Patho_Problem_List_SNOMED_CT

ValueSet containing the recommended vocabulary for describing problems, according to the IHE Patient Care Coordination Technical Framework (Vol. 2)

References

  • MII PR Patho Problem List Item

Logical Definition (CLD)

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 64572001 (Disease)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 418799008 (Finding reported by subject or history provider)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 404684003 (Clinical finding)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 409586006 (Complaint)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 248536006 (Finding of functional performance and activity)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 55607006 (Problem)
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where concept is-a 282291009 (Diagnosis interpretation)

 

Expansion

Expansion from 127.0.0.1 based on SNOMED CT International edition 01-Jul 2026
